parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of polypropylene plastic, typically flat and slightly curved for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, supporting body weight and ensuring comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It folds upward or downward along the hinge mechanism when the chair is collapsed or opened.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing structural integrity and allowing the folding mechanism to operate.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots at the joints to fold or unfold the chair, enabling compact storage and portability.
